checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are largely accurate but require refinement on the 'hierarchical headings' checkpoint. The Router marked it false due to gibberish, but visually, the typographic hierarchy (bold/larger fonts for headers) is present and consistent with menu design standards. Therefore, the visual structure passes, even if the semantic content fails. The Router correctly identified that functional components (item names, categories) are failed due to illegibility. The 'untestable' marking for category organization is appropriate since one cannot verify semantic grouping without readable text.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' as a severity 5 artifact. This is the defining failure of the image. The 'texture_anomaly' in the food imagery (severity 3) is also valid; the items are smeared and lack definition. The 'perspective_distortion' (severity 2) is minor and likely acceptable given the angle. The Image Text Auditor confirms the gibberish with low confidence scores across most blocks, reinforcing the severity 5 rating. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted slight compression/blur, which is negligible compared to the text failure.
alignment_reasoning: The image visually resembles a menu (layout, columns, borders), satisfying the geometric checkpoints. However, it fails all functional checkpoints because the text is nonsensical gibberish. A menu's primary purpose is to convey information via text; without legible text, it is not a functional menu. The Fine Grained Classifier identifies it as a menu based on visual structure, but this is a superficial alignment. The score is penalized heavily for the failure of the core functional component (readable text).
artifact_reasoning: The primary artifact is catastrophic text gibberish (Severity 5), confirmed by the Image Text Auditor's low confidence scores and nonsensical output. Secondary artifacts include smeared food imagery (Severity 3) and slight perspective warping (Severity 2). The text failure alone renders the image functionally useless as a menu, justifying the high severity. The structural integrity of the paper sheet is maintained (Topology Auditor confidence 0.98), so no physical melting of the object itself occurred, only the content generation failed.
key_defects: Catastrophic text gibberish: All text elements are nonsensical character strings, failing the primary function of a menu.
Smeared decorative imagery: Food items in corners lack structural definition and appear melted into the background.
Functional failure: Cannot organize items or list prices/names due to illegibility.
